exercises.solution:
Solution skeleton:
- General-purpose: stretch ℓ(k) > k (any polynomial stretch); distinguisher = any PPT algorithm (possibly more complex than the generator); generator = fixed polynomial time.
- Derandomization: stretch large (e.g., ℓ(k) = 2^Ω(k) in Chapter 3); distinguisher = fixed circuit of size bounded by a fixed polynomial; generator may run more time than the distinguisher.
- Space-bounded: the aspects are fixed by the space-complexity of the distinguisher (and the generator), not their time-complexity.
- Special-purpose: only limited random behavior is required (pairwise independence, small bias, hitting); these can be constructed without any computational complexity assumption.
- Moral: the same word “pseudorandom generator” covers very different objects; the three aspects disambiguate them.
